text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level. Its summit is 8,849 meters above sea level. It lies in the Himalayas on the border between Nepal and China.
K2 is the second highest mountain on Earth. Its summit is 8,611 meters above sea level. It lies in the Karakoram range on the border between Pakistan and China.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure. Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius. Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System and the closest to the Sun. It orbits the Sun in 88 Earth days.

Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System. It is a gas giant with a mass more than twice that of all the other planets combined. The Great Red Spot is a storm on Jupiter that has been observed for centuries.
Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun. It is called the Red Planet because of iron oxide on its surface. Mars has two small moons, Phobos and Deimos.
Venus is the second planet from the Sun. It is the hottest planet in the Solar System because of its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere. A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Python is a programming language created by Guido van Rossum. It was first released in 1991. Python emphasizes code readability.
Rust is a systems programming language focused on memory safety without a garbage collector. Rust 1.0 was released in 2015.
Linux is an open source operating system kernel. It was first announced by Linus Torvalds in 1991. The kernel is released under the GNU General Public License.
Git is a distributed version control system. Linus Torvalds created Git in 2005. Git tracks changes in source code.
HTTP status code 404 means that the requested resource was not found. Status code 200 means the request succeeded. Status code 500 indicates an internal server error.
The Domain Name System translates domain names into IP addresses. DNS was introduced in 1983.
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy. Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen. Chlorophyll is the green pigment that absorbs light.
Mitochondria are organelles that produce most of the chemical energy of the cell in the form of ATP. They are often called the powerhouse of the cell.
DNA carries genetic information in living organisms. The structure of DNA is a double helix. The double helix structure was described by James Watson and Francis Crick in 1953.
The speed of light in a vacuum is 299,792,458 meters per second. Nothing with mass can travel at the speed of light.
The speed of sound in air at 20 degrees Celsius is about 343 meters per second. Sound travels faster in water than in air.
The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite. The Moon orbits Earth about every 27.3 days. Apollo 11 landed the first humans on the Moon in 1969.
The Nile is a major river in northeastern Africa. It flows north through Egypt into the Mediterranean Sea. The Nile is about 6,650 kilometers long.
The Amazon River is in South America. It has the largest discharge of water of any river in the world. The Amazon rainforest surrounds the river.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth. The deepest point is the Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench. The Mariana Trench is nearly 11,000 meters deep.
Gold is a chemical element with the symbol Au and atomic number 79. Gold is a dense, soft, yellow metal.
Iron is a chemical element with the symbol Fe and atomic number 26. Iron is the most common element by mass on Earth.
Oxygen has the symbol O and atomic number 8. Oxygen makes up about 21 percent of Earth's atmosphere.
Nitrogen has the symbol N and atomic number 7. Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere.
The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications built across northern China. Construction began in the 7th century BC and continued for many centuries.
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France. It was completed in 1889. The tower is about 330 meters tall.
Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Pi is approximately 3.14159. Pi is an irrational number.
The Transformer is a neural network architecture introduced in the 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need. It relies on self-attention mechanisms.
Retrieval-augmented generation combines a retriever with a text generator. The retriever finds documents relevant to a question, and the generator uses them to write an answer.
BM25 is a ranking function used by search engines to rank documents by relevance to a query. It is based on term frequency and inverse document frequency.
